hook.text: Always tired? You might be chronically dehydrated. Here are 3 signs your body needs water.
queries: tired person rubbing eyes exhausted closeup
person drinking water glass morning kitchen

tips.text: First, dark yellow urine. If it looks like apple juice, you're behind on water. Healthy urine is light pale yellow, almost clear.
queries: glass of clear water held up to light
person filling water bottle bathroom sink
yellow lemon water glass color comparison
hand holding water bottle clear refreshing

tips.text: Second, constant brain fog. You can't focus, you forget words, you feel slow. Your brain is 75 percent water. Even 2 percent dehydration tanks your performance.
queries: person staring blankly computer screen tired
blurry vision concept hand over face
person drinking large glass water relief

tips.text: Third, headaches that won't quit. Most headaches are actually dehydration in disguise. Try drinking 20 ounces of water before grabbing painkillers.
queries: tall glass water with ice closeup macro
